items.title: Quoted commentary describes AI-generated voice and text becoming pervasive across media and communications
items.description: Simon Willison quotes Jack Despain Zhou arguing that generative AI has caused a 'great de-individualization,' with Claude's voice heard in videos and presentations and AI-written pitches appearing in inboxes.

items.title: TrustGraph masterclass argues only real ontologies can disambiguate word meanings that vector search conflates.
items.description: The video description presents a TrustGraph masterclass using a James Bond example to distinguish schemas from ontologies, arguing vector embeddings and auto-generated 'ontologies' cannot separate meanings of the same word, and that rule-based processes belong in graphs rather than tables.

items.title: Databricks rethinks read replicas for its Lakebase architecture
items.description: The Databricks blog examines the idea behind read replicas — adding capacity when an app gets busy — and rethinks their role in the Lakebase architecture.

items.title: LinkedIn post lists semantic layer standardization and PII masking as steps for AI-ready data.
items.description: The uploader describes a checklist in which a semantic layer standardizes business definitions and metrics for consistent AI-generated insights, alongside PII masking to detect and redact sensitive data.

items.title: LinkedIn post argues semantic layer hype masks a deeper need to restructure information systems.
items.description: The uploader argues that marketing momentum around the semantic layer masks a deeper need to restructure existing information systems to achieve a genuine outcome, cut off in the snippet.

items.title: Hugging Face blog introduces llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
items.description: The Hugging Face Blog post is listed as introducing a llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon hardware; no excerpt is available to describe its contents.

items.title: LinkedIn post introduces Querio as git-native analytics for humans and agents.
items.description: The uploader describes Querio as git-native analytics and offers a primer on what context and semantic layers mean, arguing AI needs context such as warehouse contents and metric definitions.

items.title: Connected Data promotes content on data modeling, semantics and the ontology spectrum
items.description: The LinkedIn post by Connected Data promotes material on data modeling, semantics, the ontology spectrum and market reality, framed around the claim that connecting data means running a better business.

items.title: UK's FCA says Meta declined joint testing of its Muse personal agent before UK rollout
items.description: WIRED reports that the UK Financial Conduct Authority complained Meta refused to share its Muse agent for joint testing ahead of its UK launch, warning against 'another force of attack' from agents.

items.title: Undisclosed AI use affected dozens of court cases in England and Wales in 2026
items.description: The Guardian reports an investigation finding at least 25 court cases affected by AI-generated witness statements, fictitious case law and nonexistent statutes, with judges complaining about misuse by lawyers, police officers and claimants.

items.title: UK Home Office approved border system without a working fix for bad data
items.description: The Register reports the UK Home Office waved through a border system despite unresolved bad-data failings that risked wrongful detention, with an ICO reprimand and a temporary correction process taking more than a year to arrive.

items.title: Scheduled AURA Live Session with Juha Korpela announced amid ontology confusion
items.description: The uploader announces a scheduled AURA Live Session with Juha Korpela, noting ongoing confusion about what an ontology is and is not, and speculating he will discuss the ontology space again.

items.title: AI-Meta Lab post discusses combining ontologies, graphs, LLMs and neural networks
items.description: The LinkedIn post by AI-Meta Lab describes combining building blocks including ontologies, graphs, algorithms, LLMs, specialized neural networks and software adapters, mixing symbolic and other approaches in many ways.

items.title: Entropy Explains episode covers ontologies with Apache Ossie and semantic models
items.description: Dr. Simon Harrer's post promotes Episode 17 of Entropy Explains on ontologies with Apache Ossie, covering entity types, relationships, rules, and mappings to semantic models and data contracts in an open Git-stored format readable by agents.

items.title: Entropy Data explainer introduces ontologies and Apache Ossie as a portable open format.
items.description: The video description presents an animated explainer on writing down what a business means in a tool-readable format, covering entity types, relationships, rules and mappings, and contrasting ontologies with semantic models via Apache Ossie.
